thread:
Nora K.: small inconsistency during today's rollout for `priority_route` flag. console shows version=3 but a handful of edge nodes still show v1.
Ethan J.: any traces? request ids?
Nora K.: sample: edge log shows If-None-Match: W/"v1-123" -> 304, used local v1. Meanwhile /internal/flags returns v3 with ETag W/"v3-789".
ci-bot: alert: flag-sync-check (priority_route) drift_rate=0.0006 INC-5102
Ethan J.: sounds like our 304 handling assumes server 304 always means "no change". after last console refactor we added header X-Flag-Seq. proxies might be dropping it.
PM-Alex: product note: we need a lightweight console indicator (sync health) so customers know rollout progress isn't blocked by infra issues.
Nora K.: quick mitigation: edge-client change: on 304, if response contains X-Flag-Seq and seq != local_seq -> issue GET. also emit metric flag.sync.304_retry{env,flag,region}.
Ethan J.: proxy change: preserve X-Flag-Seq on 304 responses. add a probe to scan proxies for header passthrough.
PM-Alex: UX: small badge next to flags with green/yellow/red and hover text. default hidden behind console.feature.sync_health.
Nora K.: runbook snippet while patch lands:
```
# check proxy headers
curl -sI https://edge-proxy.eu.internal/flags/priority_route | egrep -i 'ETag|X-Flag-Seq'
```
Ethan J.: rollout plan: land client + proxy fix, canary ap-southeast-1 at 10% for 30m. alert if flag.sync.304_retry > 0.05% over 10m.
ci-bot: canary started: edge-client v1.20.0 -> ap-southeast-1 (10%)
Nora K.: I'll open the PRs and add tests. tagging @Ethan J..
Ethan J.: I'll add the grafana tile and the proxy scanner. Thanks :thumbsup:
